name: Mother's Devotion
source:
Hot MILF and mother of 3, Clarissa has freshly divorced her abusive ex-husband.

Now she can enjoy her new found freedom .....Right? ......Right? 

Clarissa now needs to find a job to take care of her 3 children, so that they don't have to move out.

Money issues, managing children and trying to have a life again in-between.

Come and join Clarissa in this chaos of her life and find out, how all this will affect her.

[Edited from [url=https://fluffysan-sensei.itch.io/mothers-devotion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
性感摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线和三个孩子的母亲克拉丽莎刚刚与虐待她的前夫离婚。

现在她可以享受新发现的自由了……对吗？……正确的？

克拉丽莎现在需要找到一份工作来照顾她的3个孩子，这样他们就不必搬出去。

金钱问题、管理孩子以及尝试在其间重新开始生活。

快来加入克拉丽莎的混乱生活吧，看看这一切将如何影响她。
